$comment: Password policy for every account-creating and password-changing endpoint. This file is kept BYTE-IDENTICAL in backend/src/config/passwordPolicy.json and frontend/src/app/config/passwordPolicy.json; backend/tests/password-policy.test.js fails if the two diverge. The backend is the enforcement point — the frontend reads the same numbers only so the message a Center Head sees before saving is the message the API would return, instead of a round trip that ends in a 400.
